headline: OJK Says RI Banks Could Feel Impact of US Midterm Elections
summary: The OJK projects a positive impact from the US midterm elections on Indonesian banking. It expects the effect to support fund raising and growth in lending to micro, small and medium enterprises.
why: US election outcomes influence global capital flows and dollar rates, which in turn affect emerging-market banks and their funding conditions.
original_headline: OJK Sebut Bank RI Bisa Kecipratan Dampak Pemilu Midterm AS
